items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: He used to play at Tom Anderson's. ... Tom Anderson would play, you see? ... Tom Anderson had his regular bands

ctx.x: We'll check into it. Somebody else.
He used to play at Tom Anderson's. His daddy was, used to shine shoes around the thing there. Daddy's to shine shoes and he used to play bass.
Did you know Bob Lyons, by the way?
